question_preview: What are the specific acceptance conditions and payer allocation rules for company-addressed hotel folios?

workflow_preview.title: Hotel Expense Claim Precheck
workflow_preview.goal: Check hotel expense claims against the supplied policy and evidence. Identify what can proceed to a person for business approval, what needs clarification and what must stay on hold. Never approve or pay expenses.

input_fields.description: The name of the employee who submitted the claim form.
input_fields.label: Claimant Name

input_fields.description: The hotel guest's name on the submitted receipt.
input_fields.label: Guest Name

input_fields.description: The approved stay start date recorded on the claim form.
input_fields.label: Approved Start Date

input_fields.description: The approved stay end date recorded on the claim form.
input_fields.label: Approved End Date

input_fields.description: The actual stay start date on the hotel receipt.
input_fields.label: Actual Start Date

input_fields.description: The actual stay end date on the hotel receipt.
input_fields.label: Actual End Date

input_fields.description: The entity or person to whom the hotel receipt is addressed.
input_fields.label: Receipt Addressed To

input_fields.description: The amount requested on the claim form.
input_fields.label: Claimed Amount

input_fields.description: The explicitly stated employee-paid amount marked PAID on the receipt.
input_fields.label: Employee-Paid Amount Marked PAID

input_fields.description: Whether the receipt is accepted according to documented guidelines or task-owner clarification.
input_fields.label: Receipt Accepted

state_fields.description: The current isolated review status of the expense check.
state_fields.label: Review Status

actions.description: Hold the claim for missing evidence, changed trip decisions, or manager's approval.
actions.label: Hold

actions.description: Return the claim for correction due to mismatching guest names or amounts.
actions.label: Return for Correction

actions.description: The precheck is complete and the claim can proceed to a manager for business approval.
actions.label: Ready for Business Approval

source_refs.quote: If either hotel stay date differs, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay; matching amounts do not resolve this exception.

rules.statement: If the hotel stay start date differs from the approved start date, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay.

source_refs.quote: If either hotel stay date differs, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay; matching amounts do not resolve this exception.

rules.statement: If the hotel stay end date differs from the approved end date, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay.

source_refs.quote: The hotel guest must match the claimant. A known guest-name mismatch is returned for correction.

rules.statement: If the hotel guest name does not match the claimant name, return for correction.

source_refs.quote: If a required value, payer allocation or payment status is missing, hold and request the specific missing evidence.

rules.statement: If the employee-paid amount marked PAID is missing, hold the claim.

source_refs.quote: For an accepted receipt with an identified employee payment marked PAID, a known amount mismatch is returned for correction.

rules.statement: If the receipt is accepted but the claimed amount does not match the employee-paid amount marked PAID, return for correction.

source_refs.quote: Mark the documentary precheck complete only when claimant and guest match, both stay dates match the approved dates, the receipt is accepted, and the claimed amount equals the stated employee-paid amount marked PAID.

rules.statement: Mark the precheck complete only when claimant and guest match, both stay dates match, the receipt is accepted, and the amounts match.

evidence_origin: Owner-provided Cloud Shell output; not an independent cloud read.

findings: Policy acceptance remains an input rather than a rule-derived conclusion.
The paid amount combines a numeric fact and a payment-status condition.
The core evaluator ignores exists:false and checks presence instead of absence. No case was executed.
